title: Routing decision audit logging & telemetry compliance

test_cases.name: Audit record generation per decision
test_cases.input_setup: Generate routing decisions across 5 diverse encounters
test_cases.expected_result: Audit record dictionary created for every decision
test_cases.evidence: Audit record generated for 5/5 routing decisions

test_cases.name: Audit record metadata structure
test_cases.expected_result: Contains complexity, tier, and routing trigger metadata

test_cases.name: PHI-safe audit records
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect serialized to_audit_dict for clinical or demographic identifiers
test_cases.expected_result: Zero PHI present in routing audit logs
test_cases.evidence: Audit record verified 100% PHI-free (zero clinical or demographic text)

test_cases.name: Complexity classification unit test pass
test_cases.input_setup: Classify acute clinical note using complexity rules engine
test_cases.expected_result: Returns valid complexity level and latency < 5ms
test_cases.evidence: classify_clinical_complexity passed unit verification: score=2, tier=simple, latency=0.109ms

test_cases.name: Decision queryability and filtering
test_cases.expected_result: Correctly isolates all complex-tier decisions for audit reporting
test_cases.evidence: Filter by tier='complex' isolated exactly 2 complex decisions
